reason: I already bleed money on POS, accounting and the delivery apps, and my lunch special goes on the board and on Facebook for free. Another 25 € plus VAT every month to an AI I can't phone when it breaks is not something I sign up for from an ad.
objection: Who do I call when the site shows the wrong price or goes down on a Friday night? If there's no real person in Bulgaria who picks up the phone, I'm not handing my menu to a chatbot.
would_change_my_mind: A local person who sets it up with me in the restaurant, a phone number that answers in Bulgarian, and a first month free so I can see if it actually saves me time.
